info.title: DnyanGanga Career Hub – current extension API
info.description: Reference for implemented extension routes. Read alongside existing backend/agent guides for legacy routes and provider callbacks. Schemas are documentation; server validators are authoritative. No developer candidate-auth token or new password login endpoint is invented.

x-managed-authentication: Sites opaque host-scoped candidate session via trusted dispatch; direct spoofed identity headers/service bearer do not establish a candidate. Provider callbacks and scheduler have separate documented signature/secret policies.
